description: This Java source file defines a Spring Service class 'CreateInteropRequestHandler' that handles 'CREATE' commands for 'request' entities in the interoperation module of the Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and delegates the creation of transaction requests to the 'InteropService'.

classes.name: CreateInteropRequestHandler
classes.description: A handler class responsible for processing 'CREATE' commands related to interoperation requests. Implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and uses 'InteropService' to create transaction requests.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the incoming command by delegating the creation of a transaction request to the 'InteropService'. This method is transactional.
